senses.en: a complete change of form, character, or substance

example.en: The novel describes the hero's transmutation from coward to leader.
example.zh: 这部小说描写了主人公从懦夫到领袖的转变。

senses.en: the region around a planet dominated by its magnetic field

example.en: Earth's magnetosphere protects the planet from solar wind particles.
example.zh: 地球的磁层保护地球免受太阳风粒子的侵袭。

senses.en: not attractive or appealing
senses.zh: 无吸引力的，不讨人喜欢的

example.en: The hotel lobby looked cold and uninviting.
example.zh: 酒店大堂看起来冰冷而无吸引力。

senses.en: a British bat-and-ball game in which players run around four posts to score

example.en: The children played rounders after school.
example.zh: 孩子们放学后玩圆场棒球。

senses.en: with that or with it; formal or old-fashioned use

example.en: He offered his help, and therewith the problem was solved.
example.zh: 他提供了帮助，问题随之得到解决。

senses.en: the tubes in the body through which food passes after leaving the stomach

example.en: Fiber helps keep the bowels healthy.
example.zh: 纤维有助于保持肠道健康。

senses.en: all things; everything that exists or is relevant

example.en: Everything in the room was covered with dust.
example.zh: 房间里的每样东西都落满了灰尘。

senses.en: words or actions that give someone support and confidence

example.en: Her teacher's encouragement helped her keep trying.
example.zh: 老师的鼓励帮助她继续努力。

senses.en: an optical device with two lenses used to see distant things more clearly

example.en: We watched the birds through a pair of binoculars.
example.zh: 我们用双筒望远镜观察鸟。

senses.en: a fold of skin that can cover or open the eye

example.en: She closed her eyelids and fell asleep.
example.zh: 她闭上眼皮睡着了。

senses.en: lasting longer than expected or necessary

example.en: The protracted negotiations delayed the deal for months.
example.zh: 旷日持久的谈判使这笔交易推迟了几个月。

senses.en: a group that makes decisions or advises on a particular subject

example.en: The research council reviews grant applications each year.
example.zh: 研究委员会每年审查资助申请。

senses.en: the elected group that governs a town, city, or local area

example.en: The city council is responsible for local services.
example.zh: 市议会负责地方公共服务。

senses.en: in Christianity, a formal meeting of church leaders to discuss doctrine or discipline

example.en: The bishops met at a church council to discuss doctrine.
example.zh: 主教们在一次教会会议上会面讨论教义。

senses.en: material made of threads knotted or woven together with small holes, used for catching or holding things

example.en: The net was full of fish.
example.zh: 网里装满了鱼。

senses.en: to catch something with a net; to gain an amount as a profit

example.en: The fishermen netted a huge catch of fish.
example.zh: 渔民们用网捕到了一大批鱼。

senses.en: remaining after deductions such as costs, taxes, or packaging have been removed

example.en: The net weight is shown on the label.
example.zh: 净重标在标签上。

senses.en: a network of computers, especially the internet

example.en: I found the recipe on the net.
example.zh: 我在网上找到了这个食谱。

senses.en: the right or opportunity to use or enter something

example.en: Students have free access to the library.
example.zh: 学生可以免费使用图书馆。

senses.en: a way of entering a place or reaching something

example.en: The only access to the village is by road.
example.zh: 通往该村的唯一通道是公路。

senses.en: to enter, use, or get information from something

example.en: You need a password to access the account.
example.zh: 你需要密码才能访问该账户。

senses.en: a team sport in which players hit a ball with a bat and run around bases

example.en: Baseball is popular in Japan and the United States.
example.zh: 棒球在日本和美国很受欢迎。

senses.en: the ball used in baseball

example.en: The pitcher threw a new baseball.
example.zh: 投手投出一个新棒球。

senses.en: to take something that belongs to someone else without permission

example.en: Someone stole my bike last night.
example.zh: 昨晚有人偷了我的自行车。

senses.en: to move quietly and secretly

example.en: He stole quietly into the room.
example.zh: 他悄悄地溜进了房间。

senses.en: something bought for much less than its usual price
senses.zh: 便宜货；非常划算的东西

example.en: At that price, the jacket is a steal.
example.zh: 按那个价格，这件夹克真便宜。

senses.en: to choose someone for an official position by voting
senses.zh: 通过投票选举某人担任公职

example.en: Voters will elect a new mayor this year.
example.zh: 选民今年将选举新市长。

senses.en: to decide to do something; to choose

example.en: She elected to work from home.
example.zh: 她选择在家工作。

senses.en: elected to a position but not yet in office

example.en: The president-elect spoke to reporters.
example.zh: 当选总统对记者发表了讲话。

senses.en: no longer fresh; old and not pleasant to eat or use

example.en: The bread had gone stale, so I couldn't make sandwiches.
example.zh: 面包已经不新鲜了，所以我做不了三明治。

senses.en: no longer new or interesting; lacking originality

example.en: His jokes have become stale after years of repetition.
example.zh: 多年重复之后，他的笑话已经变得陈腐了。

senses.en: a ship powered by steam

example.en: The old steamer carried passengers across the lake.
example.zh: 那艘老式汽船载着乘客横渡湖泊。

senses.en: a container used for cooking food with steam

example.en: Put the vegetables in the steamer for ten minutes.
example.zh: 把蔬菜放进蒸锅里蒸十分钟。

senses.en: a type of soft-shell clam often eaten steamed
senses.zh: 可供蒸食的软壳蛤（常作复数）

example.en: We ordered a plate of steamers at the seafood restaurant.
example.zh: 我们在海鲜餐厅点了一盘蒸蛤蜊。

senses.en: not clearly defined or stated; vague

example.en: The directions he gave were indefinite, so we got lost.
example.zh: 他给的指示很模糊，所以我们迷路了。

senses.en: lasting for an unknown or unstated period of time

example.en: The strike was postponed for an indefinite period.
example.zh: 罢工被无限期推迟了。

senses.en: (grammar) referring to something not specifically identified

example.en: 'A' and 'an' are indefinite articles.
example.zh: a 和 an 是不定冠词。

senses.en: a large male bird with a crested head and a big fanlike tail with colorful eye-shaped spots

example.en: The peacock spread its beautiful tail feathers.
example.zh: 那只孔雀展开了它美丽的尾羽。

senses.en: a man who is very proud of his appearance and likes to show off

example.en: He strutted around like a peacock in his new suit.
example.zh: 他穿着新西装，到处招摇得像只孔雀。

senses.en: to walk around in a proud, showy way

example.en: He peacocked around the party showing off his watch.
example.zh: 他在聚会上招摇地走来走去，炫耀自己的手表。

senses.en: a surname, notably borne by Joseph Campbell, the American mythologist (1904–1987)

example.en: Campbell wrote a famous book about myths from around the world.
example.zh: 坎贝尔写过一本关于世界各地神话的著名书籍。

senses.en: relating to the production of offspring or new life

example.en: The reproductive system includes organs involved in producing offspring.
example.zh: 生殖系统包括与生育后代相关的器官。

senses.en: to produce or give rise to something

example.en: The new technology spawned hundreds of small businesses.
example.zh: 这项新技术催生了数百家小企业。

senses.en: to lay eggs, used of fish and amphibians

example.en: Salmon return to the river to spawn each autumn.
example.zh: 鲑鱼每年秋天回到河里产卵。

senses.en: the eggs of fish, frogs, and similar animals

example.en: Frogs lay their spawn in ponds in early spring.
example.zh: 青蛙在早春把卵产在池塘里。

senses.en: the number 1,000

example.en: The town has a population of about five thousand.
example.zh: 这个镇约有五千人口。

senses.en: the number 1,000, or a very large number of things

example.en: Thousands of people attended the concert.
example.zh: 成千上万的人参加了音乐会。

senses.en: at a fast speed

example.en: She quickly finished her homework.
example.zh: 她很快做完了作业。

senses.en: without delay; soon

example.en: The problem was quickly solved.
example.zh: 问题很快就解决了。

senses.en: a device with a screen for watching programs

example.en: They bought a new television for the living room.
example.zh: 他们给客厅买了一台新电视机。

senses.en: broadcasting programs watched on TV

example.en: She works in television.
example.zh: 她在电视行业工作。

senses.en: Douglas, a common male given name

example.en: Douglas is coming to the meeting this afternoon.
example.zh: 道格拉斯今天下午要来参加会议。

senses.en: Douglas, the capital town of the Isle of Man

example.en: The ferry arrives at Douglas, the main port of the island.
example.zh: 渡轮抵达道格拉斯，这是该岛的主要港口。

senses.en: a tooth on the edge of a gear wheel

example.en: One worn cog made the machine jam.
example.zh: 一个磨损的轮齿使机器卡住了。

senses.en: a person who is an unimportant part of a large organization
senses.zh: （组织中的）小人物；无足轻重的一员

example.en: He felt like just another cog in the corporation.
example.zh: 他觉得自己不过是公司里又一颗小螺丝钉。

senses.en: a removable cover for a pillow

example.en: She changed the pillowcases and sheets every week.
example.zh: 她每周更换枕套和床单。

senses.en: a sea creature with a soft, transparent body and long stinging tentacles

example.en: We saw glowing jellyfish drifting near the shore.
example.zh: 我们看到发光的水母在近岸漂浮。

senses.en: a large roofed structure with rows of seats for spectators at a sports ground

example.en: The fans watched the final match from the grandstand.
example.zh: 球迷们在大看台上观看了决赛。

senses.en: to behave showily in public to win attention or applause
senses.zh: （为博取喝彩而）作秀；哗众取宠

example.en: Politicians often grandstand during election campaigns.
example.zh: 政客们常在竞选期间作秀。

senses.en: (Eskimo) an older umbrella term for Inuit and Yupik peoples; regarded as outdated or offensive by many, with usage varying by region and community
senses.zh: 爱斯基摩人（用于因纽特人和尤皮克人等的旧统称；许多人认为过时或冒犯，各地区及群体的用法有差异）

example.en: The exhibit explains that Eskimo is not a preferred term for many Inuit and Yupik people.
example.zh: 展览说明，许多因纽特人和尤皮克人不愿被称为 Eskimo。

senses.en: a person who lives in a suburb

example.en: Many suburbanites commute to the city for work.
example.zh: 许多郊区居民通勤到市区上班。

senses.en: certainly, without doubt

example.en: He will assuredly arrive on time.
example.zh: 他肯定会准时到达。

senses.en: to envy someone for having something

example.en: I don't begrudge her success.
example.zh: 我并不嫉妒她的成功。

senses.en: to give or spend something unwillingly

example.en: He begrudged every dollar he had to pay.
example.zh: 他花的每一美元都心疼不已。

senses.en: in a way that things are closely packed together

example.en: The city is densely populated.
example.zh: 这座城市人口密集。

senses.en: not having the right skills, training, or qualifications
senses.zh: 不合格的；无资格的；不胜任的

example.en: He is unqualified for the teaching job because he has no degree.
example.zh: 他没有学位，所以不胜任这份教师工作。

senses.en: complete and without any conditions or limits

example.en: She offered her unqualified support for the plan.
example.zh: 她对这项计划给予了无保留的支持。

senses.en: extremely evil or shocking; morally terrible
senses.zh: 令人发指的；十恶不赦的

example.en: The court condemned the heinous crime.
example.zh: 法庭谴责了这一滔天罪行。

senses.en: lacking courage; not brave

example.en: Attacking someone from behind is a cowardly act.
example.zh: 从背后袭击别人是怯懦的行为。

senses.en: having one side larger, heavier, or lower than the other; uneven

example.en: The game ended in a lopsided victory.
example.zh: 这场比赛以一边倒的胜利告终。

senses.en: to make a low rough sound, like a frog or raven
senses.zh: 发出低哑的叫声；呱呱叫

example.en: Frogs were croaking in the pond.
example.zh: 青蛙在池塘里呱呱地叫。

senses.en: to speak with a low, hoarse voice

example.en: 'I'm fine,' he croaked.
example.zh: “我没事，”他哑着嗓子说。

senses.en: a low rough hoarse sound

example.en: We heard the croak of frogs at night.
example.zh: 夜里我们听到青蛙的叫声。

senses.en: to speak or express something in words

example.en: She said hello to everyone.
example.zh: 她向每个人问好。

senses.en: to show or give information

example.en: The clock says ten past six.
example.zh: 钟显示六点十分。

senses.en: the right or chance to express an opinion

example.en: Everyone should have a say in the decision.
example.zh: 每个人都应对这个决定有发言权。

senses.en: used to attract attention or show surprise

example.en: Say, that's a great idea!
example.zh: 哎呀，那真是个好主意！

senses.en: a room used mainly for sleeping

example.en: The apartment has two small bedrooms.
example.zh: 这套公寓有两个小卧室。

senses.en: describing a town or area where most residents commute to work elsewhere
senses.zh: （城镇或地区）住宅性的，通勤者居住的

example.en: They live in a quiet bedroom suburb outside the city.
example.zh: 他们住在城外一个安静的通勤者居住的郊区。

senses.en: a narrow way for walking, often through grass or woods

example.en: We followed a narrow path through the woods.
example.zh: 我们沿着一条穿过树林的小路走。

senses.en: the direction or route to a place

example.en: The shortest path to the station goes through the park.
example.zh: 去车站的最短路线穿过公园。

senses.en: a course of action or way of life

example.en: She chose a career path in medicine.
example.zh: 她选择了医学领域的职业道路。

senses.en: the location of a file or folder in a computer system

example.en: Check the file path before saving the document.
example.zh: 保存文档前请检查文件路径。

senses.en: a familiar or humorous name given to a person instead of their real name

example.en: Her friends gave her the nickname Sunny because she always smiles.
example.zh: 她的朋友们给她起了个绰号叫“Sunny”，因为她总是面带微笑。

senses.en: a descriptive name for a place or thing

example.en: Paris has the nickname 'the City of Light'.
example.zh: 巴黎有“光之城”的别称。

senses.en: to give a nickname to someone or something

example.en: They nicknamed the old bridge 'the Iron Giant'.
example.zh: 他们给那座老桥起了个绰号叫“钢铁巨人”。

senses.en: to decide or set something in advance, especially a fate or purpose

example.en: She seemed destined to become a great musician.
example.zh: 她似乎注定会成为一位伟大的音乐家。

senses.en: believing that people act mainly out of self-interest; distrustful of others' motives
senses.zh: 愤世嫉俗的；认为人皆自私的

example.en: He is cynical about politicians' promises.
example.zh: 他对政客的承诺持怀疑态度。

senses.en: showing contempt for accepted standards, especially for one's own benefit
senses.zh: 冷嘲的；唯利是图而不顾道德的

example.en: It was a cynical move to win votes.
example.zh: 那是一个为了拉选票而不择手段的做法。

senses.en: to state something clearly and exactly

example.en: Please specify your dietary requirements when booking.
example.zh: 预订时请说明您的饮食要求。

senses.en: to include something as a condition in a contract or agreement

example.en: The contract specifies a delivery date of June 1.
example.zh: 合同规定了六月一日的交货日期。

senses.en: to name or fix exactly what is wanted

example.en: You can specify which files to back up.
example.zh: 你可以指定要备份哪些文件。

senses.en: a small gun held and fired with one hand

example.en: The police officer carried a pistol in a holster.
example.zh: 那名警察在枪套里带着一把手枪。

senses.en: to bring a feeling, memory, or response to mind

example.en: The old song evoked memories of her childhood.
example.zh: 这首老歌唤起了她童年的回忆。

senses.en: to shake slightly because of cold, fear or excitement

example.en: Her hands trembled with cold as she spoke.
example.zh: 她说话时双手冷得发抖。

senses.en: a slight shaking movement, often caused by fear or cold

example.en: He felt a tremble in his voice.
example.zh: 他感到自己的声音有些颤抖。

senses.en: a place for someone to stay or live, such as a hotel room or lodgings

example.en: The hotel provides comfortable accommodation for its guests.
example.zh: 这家酒店为客人提供舒适的住宿。

senses.en: an adjustment or adaptation to something; a settlement or compromise

example.en: The two sides reached an accommodation after long negotiations.
example.zh: 经过长期谈判，双方达成了和解。

senses.en: complete and careful, with nothing missed

example.en: She gave the room a thorough cleaning before the guests arrived.
example.zh: 客人到之前她把房间彻底打扫了一遍。

senses.en: paying close attention to detail; careful and accurate

example.en: He is a thorough researcher who checks every source.
example.zh: 他是一位一丝不苟的研究者，会核对每一个资料来源。

senses.en: a deep, continuous low sound
senses.zh: 隆隆声；低沉的持续声响

example.en: We heard the rumble of thunder in the distance.
example.zh: 我们听到远处传来雷声的隆隆声。

senses.en: to make a deep, continuous low sound

example.en: The truck rumbled past our house.
example.zh: 卡车隆隆地驶过我们的房子。

senses.en: a metal or plastic fastener for joining two ends of a belt or strap

example.en: The belt has a strong metal buckle.
example.zh: 这条腰带有一个结实的金属扣。

senses.en: to fasten something with a buckle

example.en: Buckle your seat belt before driving.
example.zh: 开车前请系好安全带。

senses.en: to bend or collapse under pressure

example.en: The bridge buckled under the weight of the truck.
example.zh: 桥在卡车的重压下变形弯曲了。

senses.en: a serious disease spread by mosquitoes, causing fever and chills

example.en: Mosquito nets help protect travelers from malaria.
example.zh: 蚊帐有助于保护旅行者免受疟疾侵害。

senses.en: mixed or contradictory feelings about something or someone

example.en: She felt ambivalence about moving to a new city for work.
example.zh: 对于为新工作搬到新城市，她心里很矛盾。

senses.en: a translation of a film's dialogue shown at the bottom of the screen

example.en: I watched the foreign film with English subtitles.
example.zh: 我看这部外语片时开着英文字幕。

senses.en: a secondary or explanatory title of a book or film

example.en: The book's subtitle explains its main theme.
example.zh: 这本书的副标题解释了它的主题。

senses.en: to provide a film or program with subtitles

example.en: The documentary was subtitled in three languages.
example.zh: 这部纪录片配了三种语言的字幕。

senses.en: hidden and not openly stated, often referring to a hidden motive

example.en: She suspected he had an ulterior motive for offering help.
example.zh: 她怀疑他主动帮忙另有图谋。

senses.en: silly or foolish; crazy (British, informal)

example.en: It would be daft to go out without an umbrella in this rain.
example.zh: 这样的雨不带伞出去太傻了。

senses.en: to be sad, gloomy and inactive

example.en: He moped around the house all day after failing the test.
example.zh: 考试没通过后，他整天在屋里闷闷不乐。

senses.en: an official authorized to witness signatures and certify documents

example.en: You need a notary to certify this contract.
example.zh: 你需要一位公证人来公证这份合同。

senses.en: to become too big or too mature for something
senses.zh: 长大（或发展）得不再适合；因长大而弃用

example.en: Children often outgrow their clothes within a year.
example.zh: 孩子们常常一年内就长得穿不下原来的衣服。

senses.en: to grow faster or larger than someone or something else

example.en: The tech sector has outgrown the rest of the economy.
example.zh: 科技行业的增长速度超过了经济的其他部分。

senses.en: too old to be useful or suitable now

example.en: The factory still uses antiquated equipment.
example.zh: 这家工厂仍在使用陈旧的设备。

senses.en: to make someone drunk with alcohol

example.en: The strong wine quickly intoxicated the guests.
example.zh: 烈酒很快让客人们醉了。

senses.en: to excite someone greatly; make someone feel elated

example.en: The beauty of the mountains intoxicated the travelers.
example.zh: 山中美景令旅人们陶醉。

senses.en: to interfere in other people's affairs without being asked

example.en: He warned his neighbors not to meddle in his family matters.
example.zh: 他警告邻居们不要干涉他的家务事。
